paths.name: am32-core
paths.message: issue #3 section 7.2: import from 'am32-core/session' instead. The barrel re-exports the link and framing layers, so allowing it would be a rule with a hole in it. Type-only modules (am32-core/mcu, am32-core/eeprom/layout) stay reachable.

patterns.message: issue #3 section 7.2: MSP and 4-way framing live below the session layer. Reach the wire through Am32Session, via useEscSession().
issue #3 section 7.2: the link layer, its retries and its timeout policy live below the session layer. Reach the wire through Am32Session, via useEscSession().
issue #3 section 7.2: transports are constructed once, in composables/useEscSession.ts. A component must not know which transport it is on.
issue #3 section 7.2: the client boundary may construct a transport and a session, but framing belongs in am32-core. If this file needs a frame, the code does not belong here.
issue #3 section 7.2: the client boundary may construct a transport and a session, but the link layer belongs in am32-core. If this file needs a timeout, the code does not belong here.
